Main fixes: saṃtarpaṇa vs bṛṃhaṇa both 'nourishing' (unit 20), atisaṃpūraṇa as सन्तर्पण (P2), java as वेग (P1, P3), rūpa = symptoms (10), added words removed (3, 6, 8, 23), meat-juices (30).
